title: Hifdh check: Nuh and the five-surah cycle: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 47 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Hifdh check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 47. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا (٢٥) وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا (٢٦) إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا (٢٧) رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا (٢٨)

questions.q: Hifdh check: today's group recites Nuh and a passage the teacher chooses from Al-Mulk to Al-Ma'arij. Everyone else: dawrah revision and targets.
Extend: recite Al-Mulk 1 to 10 from memory.
How many ayat in Surat Nuh?
The five surahs in order are ...
Think again: Next year brings Al-Jinn and beyond. What one habit from this year will you carry into Year 9?
questions.a: For example: the daily dawrah, reciting in salah, or tasmi' with a sibling.
